purpose: Native tool foundation; calibration never establishes release qualification

trajectory.notes: 8 or 64 notes at pitches 24.. every 32 blocks, release frame 0/retrigger frame 1
trajectory.polyphony: existing instance polyphony override 8/64, independent of sound VOICES edits
trajectory.dense: all 256 native identities once; legal cyclic values (block + index) modulo domain width
trajectory.coalesced: all 256 four times, first three minima, fourth same as dense; direct lane replays final active codec writes
trajectory.parity: current native preflight compares both channels and540-byte program exactly for160blocks; runner compares cumulative audio/program fingerprint at every measured block across all three lanes

raw_record_schema.producer_begin_ns: monotonic uint64 before existing program selection and parameter producer work (including mutex acquisition)
raw_record_schema.render_begin_ns: monotonic uint64 before actual run including lock acquisition
raw_record_schema.trajectory_fnv64: hex cumulative audio/program trajectory fingerprint; integrity uses separate SHA256

gate_policy.overlap: report producer and render separately; never add overlapping thread times

external_evidence_required: Actual pre-change/current wrapper transport timing (source-linked callback/mutex comparator is available)
Actual VST2/VST3/CLAP/AU wrapper costs and DAW workflows
Actual DAW/editor concurrent save/refresh timing beyond native scheduled producer-quiescent windows

result_schema.runs: exact argv, real exit, matrix cell, summary, raw/log SHA256 or explicit unavailable
result_schema.comparisons: paired trajectory, separate producer/render p99 differences, dense/new-idle and pre-change comparison, strict gates and baseline headroom
result_schema.release_qualified: false until external evidence is reconciled by later qualification owner

baseline_attribution: Archived SQ8LPlugin.cpp/.hpp byte-identical copies, archived engine/core-math/MTS/DPF implementation; current pure codec files copied byte-identically to resolve archived Program/EditBuffer; current generated version header; sole SharedLibrary helper change is explicit fixture data-directory override used outside timed callbacks

native_concurrent_protocol.cadence: one background save then full256-identity refresh every16 audio blocks, warmup included
native_concurrent_protocol.window: producer completes before worker request; worker may overlap actual render; finite completion wait before next producer; no producer/save concurrency claim
native_concurrent_protocol.operations: actual current/archived getState editbuffer callbacks; current new accepted getters, current direct/archived per-identity codec reads under existing recursive mutex
native_concurrent_protocol.validation: outside timing compare saved string with actual post-render save and all refreshed values with post-render refresh; next program/producer cannot start until completion
native_concurrent_protocol.coordination: separate mutex/condition-variable waits excluded from production timings;5s native timeout aborts process; runner finite process timeout; worker stop/join after completion
native_concurrent_protocol.roles: save and refresh are separate worker operations; render/producer separate; never sum overlapping durations
native_concurrent_protocol.scope: finite deterministic schedule only; no general race/deadlock or wrapper/editor claim

individual_callback_sampling.blocks: at most32 measured blocks evenly spaced, step=ceil(measured_blocks/32), starting first measured block
individual_callback_sampling.scope: full actual setter/getter invocation including engine acquisition; timestamps bracket callback only; record store/validation outside callback
individual_callback_sampling.coverage: all256 identities on selected blocks, all4 setter calls for coalesced; only new lane automation workload; no baseline invented setter/getter
individual_callback_sampling.raw: raw_path.callbacks.jsonl kind/index/block/begin_ns/end_ns; raw_path.background.jsonl block/save_begin_ns/save_end_ns/refresh_begin_ns/refresh_end_ns; all monotonic nanoseconds
individual_callback_sampling.overhead: producer includes individual timestamp/recording overhead on sampled blocks; no overhead subtraction; sampling disabled on other blocks

harness_diagnostic.cli: --harness-diagnostic with current new/direct lanes; concurrent-save-refresh, zero warmup, at most2 seconds
harness_diagnostic.path: same actual native adapter, paired audio/program preflight and shared background helper; finite external process timeout required
harness_diagnostic.output: independent mode=harness-diagnostic summary and per-background diagnostic raw JSONL, timing_eligible=false/release_qualified=false; no benchmark schema3 timing records or distributions
harness_diagnostic.coverage: finite native background save/256 getter or manual refresh coordination and worker stop/join; no wrapper/editor/DAW or general race/deadlock proof
